title: Final design-system implementation audit
scope: Independent source audit plus review of already-saved screenshots; no Chrome operated. Authorized repairs are separately listed.
sourceStatus: No remaining material design-system implementation blocker identified after listed fixes; current native/build acceptance still pending.

coreComponentMapping.assessment: Uses actual recovered Header/Sidebar, ImpactTabs, ButtonGroup, FiltersStrip, FilterPanel and AIChatPanel. Responsive geometry adapts these existing components.

MetricCard composes original ProductPerformanceKpiCards CSS and both original SVG background assets. WorkspaceCard matches original SalesMixChartCard surface geometry and ItemToolbar title hierarchy; approved Overview grid is3×2.

Actual Impact Button/Select/Input/Checkbox/Popover adapters, not CSS-painted native lookalikes. One native textarea is deliberately the original AIChatPanel composer with its actual chat-input classes.
Recovered DataGrid supplies row/header styling and behavior; original ItemCardFront CSS surface is composed for product cards. Detail cards, scope notes and domain facts use shared primitives/tokens.

Recovered DataGrid hosts new domain state buttons. Text codes and dated member states are functional domain controls rather than generic imitation form chrome. Paging and narrow pair list remain subject to native checks.
Manrope and original iris/cyan series palette are reused. ScreenChart exact original tooltip/line treatment is present; the date-cloud departure is now removed.

Queue/log/library configuration use shared cards, recovered DataGrid and actual controls; ConfigurationDialog uses actual ImpactModal and ImpactTabs. Administrative acknowledgement remains a small semantic table with real ImpactCheckbox.

nonblockingReviewNotes.note: The three-column execution acknowledgement table is intentionally a small native semantic table, with12px type rather than main DataGrid14px. It is not a fake input: its checkboxes are actual Impact controls. Inspect the phone presentation; consolidate with WorkspaceTable later if one table component is required everywhere.

Metric helpers clamp to one line and do not expose their complete ReactNode text as a title. The screenshots show some reasons truncated. Global dates/definitions remain available; a future tooltip/full helper affordance would improve information access without adding persistent gray paragraphs.

ConcentrationChart still relies on Highcharts default tooltip styling while composition/trend set original tooltip treatment explicitly. Colors/fonts are correct; verify hover appearance in native QA rather than claiming pixel identity from source.
At audit snapshot this file shows the scrolled trend, not the Summary card section. Parent acknowledged and will recapture; do not use it as the Summary illustration.
